data.name: Privacy_Intro
data.value: Dialed keeps your coffee notes for you and, if you want, shares them with people you choose. This is the draft policy for the private beta; it will be reviewed before the app is opened up further.

data.name: Privacy_Stored
data.value: Your beans, bags, recipes, brews and ratings, your equipment and your settings. They live on this device first. If you create an account they are also stored on our server, so they sync between your devices and your household. Without an account nothing leaves your device.

data.name: Privacy_Account
data.value: Your account holds your name, email address and your passkeys (only the public part; the secret never leaves your device). Recovery codes are stored as hashes. There is no password.

data.name: Privacy_Photos
data.value: Photos are only taken or chosen when you press a photo button. They are stored with the bean or brew they belong to, resized on your device, and synced like your other data when you have an account. The camera is not used for anything else.

data.name: Privacy_Sharing
data.value: You decide per item who sees it: only you, your household or people who follow you. Household members can see and change what the household shares. You can leave a household or block someone at any time.

data.name: Privacy_AI
data.value: When you ask for dial-in advice, the data needed for that question (for example the bean, the method, your grind setting and taste notes) is sent to a Claude model hosted on Microsoft Foundry in Azure. It is used to answer you and is not used to train models. Nothing is sent unless you ask.

data.name: Privacy_Errors
data.value: If you leave it on in Settings, the app sends anonymous error reports: the kind of error, the app version and the device type. Never your name, email, recipes or notes.

data.name: Privacy_Control
data.value: In Settings you can export all your data as a file and delete your account. Deleting removes your account and your data from the server. Copies that other people received through sharing stay with them. A deleted account cannot be restored.

data.name: Privacy_Contact

data.name: Privacy_Push
data.value: If you allow notifications, your browser gives us an address at its push service for this device. We keep that address with your account so we can notify you; it is removed when you turn notifications off, sign out or delete your account. If you switch on low-stock or peak alerts we also keep your low-stock threshold, rest times and time zone, and the notification names the bean. A notification says only a name and what happened, and travels encrypted: the push service (Apple, Google or Mozilla) cannot read it.

data.name: Privacy_Public
data.value: A public profile is off until you switch it on in Settings. When it is on, other Dialed users can find you by your name and see your name, your avatar and the beans and recipes you set to "Everyone on Dialed", and nothing else. They cannot see your brews, bags, friends or email address, and they have to be signed in: nothing is on the open web or in search engines. Switch it off and you disappear at once; your items keep their own setting. People can report a profile, bean or recipe; the report (who, what, why) goes to the developer of the beta, who can hide a profile without deleting anything. Deleting your account removes your profile and your public items.

data.name: Privacy_Catalog
data.value: Dialed suggests beans and roasters from a catalog built from what people chose to share publicly. A bean or roaster only enters it when at least two different people made the same one public, and it holds no names, ids or anything that points back to a person (a barcode is only included when at least two people entered it). Nothing private ever enters it. If you un-share an item, switch your public profile off or delete your account, your contribution drops out at the next rebuild. Using a suggestion copies it into your own beans; nothing stays linked.
